summary: validateApp now throws if owner is missing/empty (shared-contracts bumped to 2.0.0). core-shell (platform), billing (payments) and reports (insights, not in a child ticket but also called validateApp) pass their owner, matching the team field in each package.json. One atomic PR (#1) because the lib is inlined at build time and a lib-only merge would break the apps. Assumptions: shared-contracts is an in-repo lib, so no registry release or dependency update is needed; platform-kit does not call validateApp. Owners are hardcoded to match package.json team. CI and CD green.
